# Risk of Bias analysis

```{r rob}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")
  pacman::p_load(readxl, dplyr, stringr, ggplot2, tidyr, patchwork, robvis)
})

infile <- "Data/Risk of bias.xlsx"
outdir <- "Results/RiskOfBias"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Read + keep only actual study rows (notes have Study missing)
rob_raw <- readxl::read_excel(infile, sheet = 1)
rob_studies <- rob_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(Study), str_trim(as.character(Study)) != "")

# Standardize rating labels to robvis-expected categories
# Accepts: Low / Moderate / High (case-insensitive)
normalize_judgement <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  x <- str_to_lower(x)
  case_when(
    x %in% c("low") ~ "Low",
    x %in% c("moderate", "some concerns", "unclear") ~ "Moderate",
    x %in% c("high") ~ "High",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

rob_quips <- rob_studies %>%
  transmute(
    Study = case_when(
      str_to_upper(as.character(Study)) == "ETHOS" ~ "ETHOS Engage",
      str_to_upper(as.character(Study)) == "DARLO" ~ "DARLO-C",
      str_to_upper(as.character(Study)) == "POCT"  ~ "Australian PoC Testing Program",
      TRUE ~ str_to_upper(as.character(Study))
    ),
    `Study participation` = normalize_judgement(`Study participation`),
    `Study attrition` = normalize_judgement(`Study attrition`),
    `Prognostic factor measurement` = normalize_judgement(`Prognostic factor measurement (age)`),
    `Outcome measurement` = normalize_judgement(`Outcome measurement (cirrhosis/CSPH)`),
    `Study confounding` = normalize_judgement(`Study confounding`),
    `Statistical analysis and reporting` = normalize_judgement(`Statistical analysis and reporting`)
  )

# Save the cleaned robvis-ready dataset for transparency/reuse
readr::write_csv(rob_quips, file.path(outdir, "QUIPS_robvis_input.csv"))

# QUIPS is not supported by robvis::rob_traffic_light() in robvis v0.3.0.
# Create an equivalent study-by-domain "traffic light" plot using ggplot.
domains <- setdiff(names(rob_quips), "Study")

traffic_df <- rob_quips %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(domains), names_to = "Domain", values_to = "Judgement") %>%
  mutate(
    Domain = factor(Domain, levels = domains),
    Study = factor(Study, levels = rob_quips$Study),
    Judgement = factor(Judgement, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"))
  )

traffic_cols <- c(
  "Low" = "#02C100",
  "Moderate" = "#E2DF07",
  "High" = "#BF0000"
)

na_col <- "grey60"

plot_traffic <- ggplot(traffic_df, aes(x = Domain, y = Study, fill = Judgement)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = traffic_cols, drop = FALSE, na.value = na_col) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Risk of bias") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(traffic_df$Study)))

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "Figure_RiskOfBias_QUIPS_traffic_light.png"),
  plot = plot_traffic,
  width = 11,
  height = 0.35 * nrow(rob_quips) + 2.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "Figure_RiskOfBias_QUIPS_traffic_light.pdf"),
  plot = plot_traffic,
  width = 11,
  height = 0.35 * nrow(rob_quips) + 2.5,
  bg = "white"
)

# Summary plot (overall distribution by domain)
summary_df <- traffic_df %>%
  count(Domain, Judgement) %>%
  group_by(Domain) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_summary <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Domain, y = pct, fill = Judgement)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, position = "fill") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(domains)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = traffic_cols, drop = FALSE, na.value = na_col, limits = names(traffic_cols)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Risk of bias") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Combined side-by-side figure (keep only one legend)
plot_combined <- plot_traffic + (plot_summary + theme(legend.position = "none")) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.25, 1))

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "Figure_RiskOfBias_QUIPS_combined.png"),
  plot = plot_combined,
  width = 16,
  height = max(5.5, 0.35 * nrow(rob_quips) + 2.5),
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "Figure_RiskOfBias_QUIPS_combined.pdf"),
  plot = plot_combined,
  width = 16,
  height = max(5.5, 0.35 * nrow(rob_quips) + 2.5),
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "Figure_RiskOfBias_QUIPS_summary.png"),
  plot = plot_summary,
  width = 8.5,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "Figure_RiskOfBias_QUIPS_summary.pdf"),
  plot = plot_summary,
  width = 8.5,
  height = 5.5,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Wrote:\n- ", file.path(outdir, "QUIPS_robvis_input.csv"),
        "\n- ", file.path(outdir, "Figure_RiskOfBias_QUIPS_traffic_light.png"),
  "\n- ", file.path(outdir, "Figure_RiskOfBias_QUIPS_summary.png"),
  "\n- ", file.path(outdir, "Figure_RiskOfBias_QUIPS_combined.png"))
```
